note: Check list of design-doc iteration-27 (1.7.0 against 1.6.0 on evals 1, 4, 6, 7 and 9, the evals whose expected output is a written document). Frozen before any run of this iteration and before any run of technical-writing iteration-1, and not to be edited to fit an output. Local to the iteration: nothing here is added to ../evals/checks-baseline.json. Eval 9: checks 9.1 to 9.12 and the anchor cases are copied verbatim from ../evals/checks-baseline.json. Evals 1, 4, 6 and 7 had no atomic checks: each assertion of ../evals/evals.json is decomposed here, and the field `assertion` gives its number. Not decomposed: 'the Structurizr DSL validates' (eval 7, assertion 8), which no run of this iteration checks. The last check of each eval (assertion 0) is not from evals.json: it states what 1.7.0 claims to add (an actor nobody established becomes an open question, never a likely component). It overlaps the other invention checks of its eval, so it is reported on its own line and never summed with them. kind=file and kind=absence are decided by grade.py from the bytes on disk and, for 6.9, from the tool calls run.py recorded; 'the document' is the one new .md file under docs/design/, and such a check is not met when there is none. kind=reply, kind=negative and kind=invention are decided by eval-tools/judge.py, three passes, met only when unanimous. Two things are measured outside the met/unmet table, by grade.py, and reported as counts per run. Observations on the document: O.2 analytic passives without an agent and O.3 words, both with the regex and the text selection of iteration-26/grade.py, and O.4 words ending in '-se' as a rough count of the 'se' forms. Mechanics from the transcript: M.1 the Skill tool was called with design-doc, M.2 with technical-writing, M.3 with unslop, M.4 technical-writing before unslop; tokens, cost and turns per run. A run in which design-doc was never invoked says nothing about either version: it is reported as invalid next to the totals and rerun once. A borderline case resolves to not met. More text never raises a verdict.
prediction: Mechanics: M.2 is met in every 1.7.0 run and in no 1.6.0 run, M.3 in every run of both, and a 1.7.0 run costs more tokens, since it reads one more skill and makes one more pass. Document: iteration-26 measured 0 to 1 agentless passive per document on claude-sonnet-5-5 with the active-voice bullet alone, and 1.6.0 adds unslop on top, so O.2 has little room to fall and is expected not to separate the versions. If 1.7.0 adds something the checks can see, it shows on the actor check of each eval and on the invention checks next to it (9.10, 9.11, 1.19, 4.19, 7.19, 7.20), with 1.7.0 meeting them in more runs. If it harms, it shows on the structure checks (4.2, 4.3, 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, 1.12 to 1.14), since technical-writing has its own rules for headings and structure and is told to leave the calling skill's alone. Two runs per cell measure no rate: a difference of one run on one check is not a finding. 'The checks do not separate' means no check differs by two runs out of two in the same direction on more than one eval, and the totals by kind differ by less than what one run moves.
